title: GetInstantDraftCallablePayload
description: Callable payload accepted by getInstantDraft: the draft page polls its draft with the id and the private token from its URL fragment. App Check is required; sign-in is not. After a needs_city answer the page sends the same id and token with the chosen city, which continues the same draft.

city.description: Only after a needs_city answer: the marketId of one of the markets that answer offered (a city name or alias of an open market is accepted too). Refused when the draft is not waiting for a city or the city is not an open market.
